_about: Overrides on top of the server's monster AI. What a monster casts, when and how often, now comes from the server snapshot (server-mobs.json, mob_skill_db); what each skill does comes from skill-effects.json (read from the server source).

Put here only what the project owner has seen in game that differs from the 2023 snapshot, or confirmed numbers. Keys: mobs.<monster name>.<AEGIS skill> = fields of a MobSkill to replace (see model.ts), or skills.<AEGIS> for every monster that has it.
Set "verified": true on an entry once its numbers match a reading.

PR_MAGNUS.note: Project owner, 2026-09-27: Heartless's Magnus hits a Holy-armoured Kingslayer (MDEF 33+188) for ~1,920 a wave. The server's 10 hits a wave are display only; one wave fits 180% of MATK at the element table's Holy-vs-Holy 50%. Without Holy armour that is ~3,840 a wave, which is why the owner calls Holy armour a given against Heartless. Second reading (owner, 2026-09-29): ~1,700 a tick, many ticks, on Neutral armour (MDEF 30+171) -- which does not fit ~1,920 a wave on Holy armour; unresolved, calibration unchanged.

CR_GRANDCROSS.note: Project owner, 2026-09-27: a cross-shaped area -- stand diagonal to the caster and it misses. The TAS does, unless stunned, frozen or rooted in place.

NPC_GRANDDARKNESS.note: Project owner, 2026-09-27: a cross-shaped area -- stand diagonal to the caster and it misses. The TAS does, unless stunned, frozen or rooted in place.

WL_EARTHSTRAIN.note: Project owner, 2026-09-29: walk behind the caster or Hide. The line runs away from the caster, so two cells round behind it clears it (not the radius + 1 a walk out assumes). Hiding stops it live, though the 2023 skill flags it TargetHidden.

NPC_VAMPIRE_GIFT.note: Project owner, 2026-09-29: on this server Hiding or walking out avoids it. Its damage (300% ATK, ignoring DEF, from the 2023 code) is thought too high: waiting on a reading.

SP_SWHOO.note: Project owner, 2026-09-29 (Umbral Knight): Hiding or line of sight stops it. Whether Pawn's Rod eats it is unconfirmed (owner unsure) -- the playbook leaves Rod out. ~135-200k on a 28.7k-HP Kingslayer: never tanked.

NPC_EARTHQUAKE.note: Project owner, 2026-09-27: King's Gambit cannot stop it (server IgnoreLandProtector). Hiding dodges it unless the boss reveals you (boss-protocol swings break Hiding: engine hidingStops), or run out.

WL_COMET.note: The 2023 row waits on skill 288 (Land Protector), which Ifrit never casts: its 'SA_LANDPROTECTOR' row is id 2299, SC_MANHOLE; the owner dodges Comet every fight, so it comes live, likely after the Manhole (owner, 2026-09-29) -- unconfirmed. Damage: the owner's log (2026-09-29) shows 10 x 5,886 (and on another cast 10 x 3,742 -- further from the centre, it seems); the client splits Comet's one hit into 10 (HitCount -10). 58,860 in all against the 2023 formula's ~20,700 (250 + 6 x INT = 1,066%): ratio scaled to 3,030% to the inner reading. Tanking it killed him every time.

NPC_EARTHQUAKE.note: Project owner, 2026-09-29: never seen Ifrit cast Earthquake. The 2023 row waits on skill 288 (Land Protector), which Ifrit never casts, so it stays off. With it on, its 6 s casts kept Ifrit off the player (current profile 99% wins); without it, 69%.

RG_BACKSTAP.note: Project owner, 2026-09-28: 'when I see Back Stab I walk out of its cast range, and keep walking' -- its 1.5 s cast bar is the tell for the Cloud Kill that always follows (afterskill 212). Walking out dodges the stab itself too.

NPC_VAMPIRE_GIFT.note: Patch 15 (the project owner, 2026-09-26): it no longer reaches you through Hiding. The 2023 snapshot had no hide check on it.

RK_DRAGONBREATH.note: Project owner, 2026-09-27: Jormungandr's lair has cover; the long casts are line-of-sighted.

notes.Njord Zealot: The owner's "Valley of Death" is WM_DEADHILLHERE (Dead Hill Here): on the server it only revives a dead player, so it does nothing in a fight (skill.cpp:11388-11400).
notes.Godly Seeker: The owner saw Autumn Blood come below 50% HP; the snapshot calls it below 65% (myhpltmaxrate 65). The snapshot is used until a reading says otherwise.
